eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Summit, UT; at 2:16 PM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 3:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: All residences between Hog Back Summit County to West Henefer Road is in Go Status for the Rocky Canyon Fire. Evacuate Now. Follow designated evacuation routes. Contact 911 if assistance is needed to evacuate. Do not delay in order to gather additional belongings. A temporary shelter has been opened at the Henefer LDS Chapel at 709 N Main St. in Henefer. Additional information will be provided as it comes available at https://www.summitcounty.info/emergency and Utah Fire Info.
